prompt.alinti: You can now build an entire video channel on code alone. No video model, no credits, no subscription and no limit on length.

Missing a shot? It generates custom motion graphics to fill it.

Want something changed? Chat with it and it updates the scene.
Just like that, your long-form video is ready to upload.
Comment VID and I'll send you the full setup for Claude, Cursor, Codex, or whichever AI you use.
